title: Restriction of sheaf-module colimits to an open
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space with a sheaf of commutative rings $\mathcal O_X$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open immersion, and write $\mathcal O_U=j^{-1}\mathcal O_X$. For a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules $\mathcal M$, let $\mathcal M|_U=j^{-1}\mathcal M$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. If $(\mathcal M_i)_{i\in I}$ is a small diagram with colimit $(\mathcal M,(c_i)_i)$ in $\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], then $(\mathcal M_i|_U)_{i\in I}$ has colimit $(\mathcal M|_U,(c_i|_U)_i)$ in $\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_U)$; moreover this colimit is the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the sectionwise colimit of the restricted presheaves. This is Modules, Lemma 01AH(2),(3) (with open restriction as in Sheaves, Section 009E).

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01AH(2),(3) (existence, sectionwise description, and exactness of filtered colimits), together with Sheaves, Section 009E (restriction to an open and sheafification of presheaf colimits)
